mapper.select: select * from s2_chat_context where chat_id=#{chatId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into s2_chat_context (chat_id, turn_num, modified_at, query_user, query_text, rewritten_text, semantic_parse, entity_chain, filter_stack, coreference_info, ext_data) values (#{chatId}, #{turnNum}, now(), #{queryUser}, #{queryText}, #{rewrittenText}, #{semanticParse}, #{entityChain}, #{filterStack}, #{coreferenceInfo}, #{extData}) on duplicate key update turn_num = values(turn_num), modified_at = now(), query_user = values(query_user), query_text = values(query_text), rewritten_text = values(rewritten_text), semantic_parse = values(semantic_parse), entity_chain = values(entity_chain), filter_stack = values(filter_stack), coreference_info = values(coreference_info), ext_data = values(ext_data)
